messages.author: Ge Song
messages.body:
Dear Community,
In sander output of QM/MM calculation, the SCF energy includes both the self energy of the QM region and the coupled energy between the QM and MM atoms. I wonder if it is possible to decompose the SCF energy directly in Amber and get these two parts individually.
Best regards,
Ge Song

messages.author: Timothy Giese
messages.body: It cannot print that kind of decomposition. To calculate the QM energy in the absence of MM atoms, one could use cpptraj to strip all atoms from the trajectory and parameter files except for the QM region and then reevaluate the gas phase QM energy of each configuration.
